summary.text: Tom Young is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 37 since January 1, 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business executive, he chairs the Workforce and Higher Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Tom Young was born in Dayton, Ohio, and lives in Washington Township, Ohio, according to Ballotpedia.
He earned a B.A. from Miami University in 1980, and his career experience includes working as the senior vice president of a wealth management firm.
Ballotpedia lists Young's tenure in the Ohio House of Representatives as beginning in 2021, with his current District 37 term starting January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he chairs the Workforce and Higher Education Committee and serves on the Financial Institutions, House Finance and Public Insurance and Pensions committees.
Tom Herner (D) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
